question_text: Outline how encryption protects the confidentiality of a transmitted report.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: An encryption algorithm uses a key to transform plaintext into ciphertext. A recipient with the appropriate decryption key can reconstruct the readable report; an interceptor without it cannot readily do so.

marking_points.criterion: Appropriate key required to recover content.
